name: yeti_imp
pixel_processing: Original assembled PNGs only; exact half-scale premultiplied-alpha Lanczos resize, transparent trim, duplicate bitmap sharing, atlas packing. No generated or redrawn artwork.
foot_point_method: Each source action uses a fixed reference-frame ground line and the midpoint of both feet within its bottom 20 source pixels; Land uses its last landed frame. These are reproducible alignment anchors, not unavailable original PAM pivots.

damage_art.note: No original PAM/rig or separate damaged walking/eating sequences is included in the source package. The source death begins headless with one arm absent.

timing.note: The source is one still PNG; 1 second is only a display hold.
